title: Quest Foglight for Databases baseRmiServiceExporter Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code… (CVE-2026-92190)
description: CVE-2026-92190 is a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases. It arises from insecure deserialization in the baseRmiServiceExporter bean, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. The flaw is due to improper validation of user-supplied data before deserialization.
